note: Known jank the zero-jank gate (multiplayer-jank-journey.mjs) tolerates until fixed. Each entry names the visit (role/state/width/load/surface, * matches one part), the kind, the element and the measured maximum; a failure above 1.5x that value, on another element or in another visit fails the gate. Remove an entry when its fix lands; the gate notes entries it no longer observes.

entries.why: A member's empty rail: its 'model connection isn't working' line moves by under a pixel as the rail opens, about 500 ms after the click (so it lands either side of the input window). Seen before and after the 4 November lazy-rail fix; not caused by the rail's code arriving.
